_readme: Central config for Halo's real-world extractors. THE KEY SWITCH is runtime.allow_network. It is FALSE here because this Claude sandbox blocks external APIs. On YOUR OWN machine/server with internet, set it true (edit this file) OR run with the env var HALO_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 — then every client below hits the real open APIs. Nothing else needs to change.

osm._note: OpenStreetMap: geocode with Nominatim, then Overpass for POIs around each locality. Data is ODbL (attribution required — we store the node URL). Please self-host or use a mirror for heavy runs; the public servers are shared goodwill infrastructure.
osm._robots_note: respect_robots is FALSE for OSM because Nominatim/Overpass are DOCUMENTED PUBLIC APIs with their own usage policies — robots.txt targets HTML crawlers, not API clients. We instead honour those policies: an identifying User-Agent + contact email, and the *_min_delay_seconds rate limits below. This is standard for every OSM client. Set a real contact email (runtime.contact_email or HALO_CONTACT_EMAIL) — Nominatim can 403 placeholder/absent identification.
osm._grid_note: Split the city bbox into grid x grid tiles and scrape each tile (one request per tile, all categories unioned). Higher grid = smaller/faster queries that never 504, and deeper coverage — 4 => 16 tiles. Raise to 6-8 for exhaustive pulls (more requests, slower).
osm.self_host_note: For city-scale nightly runs, self-host Overpass (docker: wiktorn/overpass-api) and Nominatim, then point overpass_url/nominatim_url at localhost. This removes rate limits and is the polite way to pull thousands of POIs.

news._note: Prefer RSS/JSON. HTML crawling only where robots.txt allows (allow_html_crawl is a HINT; the fetcher still checks robots at run time).

govdata._note: data.gov.in — India's OFFICIAL Open Government Data API (the legitimate route to registries/census/statistics). Get a FREE key: register at https://data.gov.in -> profile -> 'Generate API Key'. Put it in HALO_DATAGOV_KEY (env) or api_key below. Then find Vadodara/Gujarat datasets on data.gov.in, copy each resource UUID into resource_ids, and run:  python scripts/extract/extract_govdata.py . Raw rows are saved to data/processed/govdata_<id>.json for inspection/mapping.

directories._note: Local business directories. The crawler ALWAYS fetches robots.txt first and honours User-agent/Disallow/Crawl-delay. base_url is a template with {locality},{category},{page}. selectors are regex fallbacks; swap for a real HTML parser (bs4) when you enable a source. Every source starts enabled=false — turn one on only after you have read its robots.txt and terms.
